chunks: Perennial gardens; they will enter them, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus will God reward the pious.
ai.seo_question: What is the specific reward promised to the pious (al-muttaqin) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Gardens of Eternity' (Jannat 'Adn) signifies the permanent abode of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful, emphasizing that the ultimate reward is not merely material but the nearness to Allah. This verse underscores the concept of divine justice (Adl), where the 'muttaqin'—those who embody both knowledge and piety—are granted 'what they wish,' reflecting the fullness of their spiritual realization. It serves as a cornerstone for understanding the eschatological hope in Twelver Shi'ism, linking earthly devotion to eternal bliss.
